# DMARC, DKIM and SPF email security

Honest caveats: you need DNS management access for your domain and access to your mail server/MTA config (Postfix, Exchange, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365); start DMARC at p=none to monitor before enforcing, since an aggressive policy can break legitimate mail flows.
